name: gaming-admin-panel
description: Gaming Arena administrative interfaces, privileged workflows, and staff access controls.
objectives: Assess staff authentication, role transitions, privileged APIs, tenant separation, approval workflows, and audit logging.
Test privilege escalation, IDOR, CSRF, session fixation, injection, and chained paths from lower-privilege accounts.
Verify that administrative actions are bound to the expected actor, target, and approval context.
operational_constraints: Use operator-provided staff test accounts with the minimum required roles.
Use non-production records and avoid changing real account, catalog, or entitlement state.
